senses.definition: In a nervous manner; feeling or displaying nervousness.
examples: He paced nervously as he waited for the important phone call.

quotes.text: Then he could see the modest bookseller, somewhat clammy in his extremities and lost within his academic robe and hood, nervously fidgeting his mortar-board, haled forward by ushers, and tottering rubescent before the chancellor, provost, president (or whoever it might be) who hands out the diploma.
quotes.reference: 1919, Christopher Morley, “Again the Narrative is Retarded”, in The Haunted Bookshop, Garden City, N.Y.: Doubleday, Page & Company, →OCLC, page 171:

quotes.text: She nervously undressed in the dancing beams of the Fidra lighthouse, giving it all away before it's too late
